verification_decision.scope: Approved six-source conditional creator expert-method authoring guidance and eight matched debugging observations. No debugging source change, new test assertion, installation or general performance claim.

binding_constraints.value: At most 12 charged subject evaluation starts including partial and failed starts; four scenarios by three conditions.

preferences_applied: Reuse adequate existing checks; run focused first; select aggregate surface only after actual diff.
The root selected run-only existing checks and independent review; these choices are CheckSpecs, not a required_tdd=false or required_check policy mandate.
capability_limits: Native usage and elapsed observations are available; no validated monetary cost or backend implementation equivalence. Broader filesystem reads are technically possible. The four constructed pairs are unblinded single samples; creator behavioral value remains unmeasured.

tdd_choice.rationale: Selected executable suites are run-only. Prose guidance and observational scenario fixtures have no selected new test assertions or meaningful preproduction RED requirement.

omitted_checks_and_rationale: Existing focused suites plus both relevant aggregate validators cover the actual six-source change. Full repository suites would add unrelated surfaces; no uncovered executable behavior was identified.
No new tests mirroring skill prose, hypothesis counts, phrase presence or word limits.
No installer mutation or native activation measurement; explicit supplied-skill behavior only.
verification_decision.stop_rule: Close only the named due checks with current supported evidence; keep comparative findings bounded. Stop at 12 charged starts or three consecutive unproductive semantic cycles under the shared guard. Material scope/access/cost/risk/acceptance changes require root decision; do not tune on held-out cases.

normalization.meaning: Preserve original history and all original CheckSpecs/TddChoice. Remove root preferences incorrectly encoded as binding policy; add the three already executed aggregate/diff CheckSpecs selected after diff discovery. No source, test, budget, approval or oracle change.
